description: For a human who wants to give their AI agent money but does not know crypto: returns a tailored 3-step plan (zh-TW or English) - 1) create their own non-custodial AI wallet with email sign-in (Coinbase Agentic Wallet), 2) top up by region (card where supported; Taiwan: MAX/BitoPro USDC, network caveats; existing USDC) with every fee and regional limit, 3) set per-call/daily caps (wallet + optional MoneyTools gateway spend controls) and get an MCP config plus a prompt to paste into the AI, plus a dashboard link for spend and receipts. Free, unlimited, no quota used; MoneyTools never holds user funds. Lists what is unverified.
